title: pi-account-guard configuration
description: The file ~/.pi/agent/account-guard.json: zones, the default zone, zone tags per account and place rules. See DESIGN.md section 4. A schema cannot check references between fields, so two rules are enforced only by the guard when it reads the file: every zone named in defaultZone, an account tag or a place rule must be declared in zones, and no two accounts may share a (provider, source) pair.

declaredZoneName.description: A zone name. It must also appear in zones (checked by the guard). unknown is reserved for accounts with no tag and cannot be declared or referenced.

note.description: Free text for the reader. Matching ignores it.

provider.description: The provider id that pi uses.

source.description: The auth source, for example oauth, stored-key or env:<VAR>.

zones.description: The zones this account may be used in. An account is either untagged (absent from the file) or in at least one zone.

path.description: An absolute directory or one starting with ~. The rule applies to it and everything below it.

remote.description: A glob matched against the normalized host/path of every git remote.

zones.description: Every zone. Defaults to ["work", "personal"] when absent.

defaultZone.description: The zone of a place that no rule matches. Defaults to personal when absent.

places.description: Place rules. File order is precedence: the first match wins.
